messages:
Sasha R: Quick sync — we need a concrete rollout plan for the new regional routing + fallback behavior (v3). Goal: staged regional rollout with parallel canaries + an A/B slice for quality checks, and automated fallback to cheap-quantized models on surge.

Jon P: +1. Can we keep it simple: NA -> EU -> APAC, with a 1% global A/B for quality, then phased region increases?

Maya L: Prefer starting EU first (regulatory customers live there). Suggest EU 0.5% canary, NA shadow, then expand if telemetry is green.

Frank G: We need clear fail criteria. Propose immediate rollback if error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute or p50 token-latency increases by > 150ms for two consecutive 5m windows. Also cost spike > 30% on token spend for the slice.

Sasha R: Good. Let's codify steps + flags. High level: 1) A/B slice 0.5% EU (flag: rr_v3_eu_ab) 2) Shadow NA traffic to compare 3) If green for 24h, ramp EU to 5% and NA to 1% 4) Add APAC last.

Jon P: How long is the canary observation window at each step? 24h seems long. Can we do 3 x 1h checks with different traffic heat (peak/off-peak)?

Maya L: For safety windows we should require 3 successful 1h gates OR 24h continuous green — whichever completes first. Keeps speed but preserves safety.

Frank G: Also add perf regression test against golden prompts set (prompt-eval-v3). If eval score drops > 2.5 pts, block.

Sasha R: Agreed. Telemetry we need on: p50/p95 latency, error rate, completion divergence (BLEU-ish), token cost per request, and rollout-specific anomalies. Ops: can you ensure Alerts in Console for these thresholds? @Ops Bot

Ops Bot: setting alerts: rr_v3_p50 > +150ms (5m), rr_v3_p95 > +300ms (5m), rr_v3_errors > +0.5% (5m), rr_v3_cost > +30% (1h), eval_drop > 2.5 pts (continuous). Will post links.

Sasha R: Flag definitions (draft):
```
rr_v3_eu_ab: {type: ab, regions: [EU], percent: 0.5} 
rr_v3_eu_phase: {type: rollout, regions: [EU], percent: 5} 
rr_v3_na_shadow: {type: shadow, regions: [NA], percent: 0} 
rr_v3_global_failover: {type: fallback, target: model-quantized-v2} 
```
Keep them short in code.

Jon P: For the A/B we should set sampling seed so clients get stable assignment for 72h. Also record per-client bucket.

Maya L: Customer-driven asks: Enterprise customers on EU Dedicated want an opt-in override to stay on v2. Add exemption tag: customer_flag_exempt.

Frank G: Rollback playbook: automated rollback if any alert fires twice within 15m; manual review otherwise. On rollback: set rr_v3_global_failover=true, reduce rollout flags to 0%, notify shiproom, create postmortem stub.

Sasha R: Can we run a dry-run shadow with full routing but no surface change for 12h first (low cost)? That will catch infra and KV-cache mismatch problems.

Ops Bot: Dry-run scheduled for tomorrow 02:00 UTC for 12h. Will post logs to #release-war-room and attach perf traces.

Jon P: Testing matrix for AB: metrics to compare between control and v3: latency, cost, hallucination score, rejection-rate, avg tokens. We'll compute uplift and run statistical tests (t-test / bootstrap).

Maya L: Who owns the statistical test harness? Product or ML infra?

Frank G: ML infra owns eval harness; product owns cutover decisions. We'll provide the golden prompts and thresholds.

Sasha R: Action items:
- Frank: write fail/rollback thresholds + postmortem template (today EOD)
- Ops: wire alerts and schedule dry-run (done)
- Jon: add sampling seed + session bucket logic to routing lib (48h)
- Maya: draft enterprise opt-out flag + customer communication (48h)
- Sasha: coordinate shiproom + create rollout ticket with steps and time windows (today)

Jon P: One more — add fallback behavior when GC pressure or GPU OOMs occur: prefer model-quantized-v2, and if that fails, route to hosted-lite with degraded SLOs. Add reason codes to traces.

Sasha R: Nice. Keep the rollout to low-traffic windows for the first two ramps. We'll aim to start EU 0.5% next Tue 02:00 UTC after dry-run metrics are reviewed.

Frank G: I'll prepare the golden-prompt eval set and baseline numbers.

Maya L: I'll prep customer messaging template and opt-out flow UI copy.

Sasha R: Thanks all. I'll post the rollout ticket and add a short checklist to the shiproom doc. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: rr_v3-dryrun -> 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z (12h). Notifications enabled.

Sasha R: If anyone has objections to the thresholds or timings, call them out here within the day. Otherwise I'll mark this as the plan and start the ticket.
